title: 第十五章 骂你野狗第十六章 强横打脸
slug: 柳无邪和徐凌雪的小说
content_zh:
这一次没有选择轻纱遮面，这次宴会代表徐家，必须要给足万家的面子。
两人联袂走出徐家，引来无数下人驻足观望，小姐貌若天仙，在所有下人心目中，宛如仙女一般存在。
坐上备好的马车，车厢里面很宽敞，两人面对面坐着，谁也没说话。
“你对万家了解多少？”
柳无邪打破了沉默，百妖会不是表面上那么简单。
“一百年前，万家老祖从一名乞丐，突然一夜之间崛起，得到神秘驯兽术，凭靠强大的驯兽本领，建造斗兽场，供应武者修炼，连帝都城许多天骄，前来观摩，现任家主万荣哲更是一代枭雄，四阶妖兽正是被他驯服，名震大燕皇朝。”
徐凌雪缓缓道来，沧澜城所有家族资料，她掌握的非常清楚。
“驯兽术，有点意思！”
摸了摸鼻子，前世在仙界，的确有驭兽斋这样的宗门，他们对驯兽一道，有独特的技巧。
一次机缘巧合，他跟驭兽斋宗主有过一段交流，从他身上学习到很多御兽知识，最后他才得知，所谓的驭兽之术，不过掌握了妖兽一些习性，加以调教。
真正的驭兽术，不仅掌握了妖族习性，更懂得妖族语言，这才是驭兽之道。
妖兽分为很多种，有些妖兽灵智极高，修炼到一定程度，可化为人形，口吐人言。
大部分都是低级妖兽，他们的灵智远不如人族，想要将它们驯服，最好的办法，摸透它们的习性，找到克制它们的弱点，才能乖乖的听话。
这些话当然不会告诉徐凌雪，马车在缓缓前行，这次的百妖会在万家最大的一座斗兽场举办。
占据方圆数十里，背靠着落日山脉，有四座大门，其中一座留给妖兽行走，其他三座大门，均可自由出入。
大半个时辰之后，马车停在东门区域，两人下车，拿出请帖，万家的侍卫，很热情的将他们领进去。
穿过一条长长的廊桥，里面的空间陡然变大，两侧柱子用最原始的青条石雕刻，显得古朴沧桑。
廊桥下面，是一座座斗兽场，地面上还有没被打扫干净的血迹，一阵阵腥味传上来。
穿过廊桥，前面的视线陡然开阔，进入一片观赏区，大概有数万平米左右，分为好几个区域。
分为三个等级，区域也有大小之分，普通人坐的位置，从西门进入，一些小家族从北门进入，四大家族以及各大天骄则是由东门进入。

严格的等级划分，东面区域最小，能容纳一千人左右，整齐的摆放着桌子。
刚一进来，人声鼎沸，许多人早已赶到，两人刚一踏入，大量的目光看过来。
“徐姑娘，柳公子，快里面请。”
万家弟子走出来，很热情的招呼，请他们进去，除了城主之外，四大家族代表沧澜城最高位置，今天有些奇怪，在四大家族更高的位置，还有几张桌子，显然给尊贵的客人准备，几名青年才俊轻声交谈。
“多谢！”
徐凌雪轻轻说道，樱唇贝齿，口生芬芳，惹来很多人注意。
“那不是徐家千金吗，她怎么也来了。”
人群传来一声惊呼，无数道目光，刷刷的朝这边聚集过来，多少人想要一睹徐家千金的真容。
连普通区域，都被惊动了，各种惊艳声，此起彼伏。
坐在上首的几名青年才俊，突然出现的骚动打断了他们交谈，一起看向这边。
中间青年男子眼眸突然一缩，定格在徐凌雪的脸上，眼眸中闪烁出强烈的占有欲，很快一闪而逝。
“此女是谁？”
青年呼吸有些急促，他出生帝都城，见过美女不计其数，眼前出现的这名女子，集天下之美貌融于一身，完美的没有一丝瑕疵。
“回禀薛公子，此女叫徐凌雪，是沧澜城徐家千金，就在前几天，跟一个废物结婚了，不过我听人说，至今还是处子之身。”
右侧青年赶紧站起来，一脸献媚之色，把徐凌雪的资料，一五一十道出。
说话的青年叫田野泉，田家一名天骄，也被邀请之列，这一次很奇怪，四大家主都没出现，好像是专门为他们年轻人举办的一场宴会。
“我在帝都城好像听说过此女，说她是帝都城第一美女，没想到今日一见，远要比传说中还要漂亮。”
薛公子点了点头，如此绝世佳人，传到帝都城倒也不足为奇。
“这样的大美人，嫁给了一个废物，真是暴殄天物，只有我们薛公子，才能配得上这样娇滴滴的大美人。”
左侧的青年跟着站起来，同样是一脸献媚，此人叫万不同，万家年轻一辈佼佼者，实力不低，听说已经参悟到先天之灵。

无形中拍了一个马屁，让薛公子很受用，嘴角浮现一抹笑意。
柳无邪跟徐凌雪双双落座，在他们身前，还有一张空桌子，留给松家的人。
左边是万家的位置，身前是松家的位置，右侧是田家的位置，徐家在四大家族排名居末，从桌椅摆放上就能看出来。
面对四周一道道火辣的目光，徐凌雪脸上露出少许不悦，还是隐忍下来，父亲告诫他，多听，多看，不要多说。
content_en:
This time, she did not choose to cover her face with a veil. On behalf of the Xu family at this banquet, she must give the Wan family enough face.
The two walked out of Xu's house together, attracting countless servants to stop and watch. The young lady looked like a fairy, and existed like a fairy in the minds of all the servants.
They got into the prepared carriage, which was very spacious. The two sat facing each other, neither of them speaking.
"How much do you know about Wanjia?"
Liu Wuxie broke the silence. The Hundred Demons Association was not as simple as it seemed.
"One hundred years ago, the ancestor of the Wan family suddenly rose from a beggar overnight and acquired the mysterious beast-taming skills. With his powerful beast-taming skills, he built a colosseum to provide training for warriors. Even many geniuses from the imperial capital came to observe. The current head of the family, Wan Rongzhe, is even more powerful. It was he who tamed the fourth-level monsters, which made him famous in the Yan Dynasty."
Xu Lingxue slowly said that she had a very clear grasp of all family information in Canglan City.
"The art of taming animals is interesting!"
I touched my nose and found that in my previous life in the fairy world, there was indeed a sect like the Beast Taming House. They had unique skills in taming beasts.
By chance, he had an exchange with the master of the Beast Controlling Studio, and learned a lot of knowledge about beast control from him. Finally, he learned that the so-called beast control technique is just to master some habits of monster beasts and train them.
The true art of controlling beasts is to not only master the habits of the monsters, but also understand the language of the monsters. This is the way to control the beasts.
There are many types of monsters. Some monsters have extremely high intelligence and can transform into human form and speak human words after being trained to a certain level.
Most of them are low-level monsters. Their intelligence is far inferior to that of humans. If you want to tame them, the best way is to understand their habits and find their weaknesses to restrain them, so that you can be obedient.
Of course these words would not be told to Xu Lingxue. The carriage was moving forward slowly. This time the meeting of hundreds of demons was held in the largest colosseum in Wanjia.
Occupying a radius of dozens of miles, with the Sunset Mountain Range at its back, there are four gates, one of which is reserved for monsters to walk around, and the other three gates can be entered and exited freely.
More than half an hour later, the carriage stopped at the east gate area. The two got out of the car and took out their invitations. The Wan family's guards led them in enthusiastically.
After crossing a long covered bridge, the space inside suddenly becomes larger. The pillars on both sides are carved with the most primitive blue stone, which looks primitive and vicissitudes of life.
Under the covered bridge, there are Colosseums. There are still blood stains on the ground that have not been cleaned up, and waves of fishy smell are coming up.
After crossing the covered bridge, the view in front suddenly widens and enters a viewing area, which is about tens of thousands of square meters and is divided into several areas.
It is divided into three levels, and the areas are also divided into different sizes. Where ordinary people sit, they enter from the west gate, some small families enter from the north gate, and the four major families and the major geniuses enter from the east gate.
Strictly divided into levels, the east area is the smallest and can accommodate about a thousand people, with tables arranged neatly.
As soon as they entered, there was a buzz of people. Many people had already arrived. As soon as the two stepped in, a lot of eyes came over.
"Miss Xu, Mr. Liu, please come in quickly."
The disciples of the Wan family came out, greeted them warmly, and invited them in. In addition to the city lord, the four major families represented the highest positions in Canglan City. It was a bit strange today. There were several tables in the higher positions of the four major families, obviously prepared for distinguished guests, and several young talents were chatting softly.
"Thank you!"
Xu Lingxue said softly, her lips were white and her mouth was fragrant, attracting the attention of many people.
"Isn't that the daughter of the Xu family? Why is she here?"
There was an exclamation from the crowd, and countless gazes gathered in this direction. How many people wanted to see the true appearance of the daughter of the Xu family.
Even the ordinary area was shocked, and all kinds of amazing sounds came one after another.
The few young talents sitting at the top were interrupted by the sudden commotion, and they all looked this way.
The eyes of the young man in the middle suddenly shrank and fixed on Xu Lingxue's face.A strong possessive desire flashed in his eyes, which quickly disappeared.
"Who is this woman?"
The young man's breathing was a little rapid. He was born in the Imperial City and had seen countless beauties. The woman who appeared in front of him had all the beauties in the world blended into one, perfect without a single flaw.
"Reporting to Mr. Xue, this girl's name is Xu Lingxue. She is the daughter of the Xu family in Canglan City. She married a loser just a few days ago. However, I heard that she is still a virgin."
The young man on the right stood up quickly, with a flattering look on his face, and told Xu Lingxue's information in detail.
The young man who spoke was called Tian Tianquan. A talented person from the Tian family was also invited. This time it was strange that the four heads of the family did not show up. It seemed like it was a banquet specially held for their young people.
"I seem to have heard of this girl in Imperial City. She was said to be the most beautiful woman in Imperial City. I didn't expect that when I saw her today, she was far more beautiful than the legend."
Mr. Xue nodded. It is not surprising that such a peerless beauty has spread to the imperial capital city.
"It would be a waste of time for such a great beauty to marry a loser. Only we, Mr. Xue, can be worthy of such a delicate beauty."
The young man on the left stood up, also with a flattering look on his face. His name was Wan Tong Tong. He was a leader of the younger generation of the Wan family. His strength was not low. It was said that he had already comprehended the innate spirit.
It was an invisible flattery, which made Mr. Xue very useful, and a smile appeared on the corner of his mouth.
Liu Wuxie and Xu Lingxue both sat down. In front of them, there was an empty table reserved for the Song family.
On the left is the position of the Wan family, in front of you is the position of the Song family, and on the right is the position of the Tian family. The Xu family ranks last among the four major families, which can be seen from the arrangement of tables and chairs.
Facing the fiery looks from all around, Xu Lingxue showed a little displeasure on her face, but she still tolerated it. Her father warned him to listen more, see more, and don't talk too much.
